title: Version-lock rescue routing and retirement orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Customers can pin requests to exact model versions for stability. When a pinned instance becomes unavailable (regional outage, kernel regression, incompatible quantization or planned retirement), we need a deterministic, auditable, and customer-configurable rescue path that preserves compatibility guarantees and minimizes user-visible regressions. Goals: 1) Define a fallback policy model that operators and customers can understand and reason about; 2) Expose a compact policy DSL in pin configs and Console UI; 3) Provide a graceful retirement orchestration (announce -> warn -> auto-route -> final-retire) with migration telemetry and rollback hooks; 4) Ensure observability/SLOs, audit trail, and opt-out for strict pin enforcement. This ticket scopes the policy design, config schema, API surface, runtime routing algorithm, and rollout plan for the rescue routing + retirement orchestration feature.
acceptance_criteria: Policy DSL defined and documented: region preference, variant ladder, strict vs permissive modes, retirement windows
Config schema added to model pin API and Console with validation and defaults
Runtime implements fallback ladder prioritization with weighting and capacity-aware decisions
Deprecation orchestration implements phased announcement/warning/auto-route/retire with email and console notifications
End-to-end tests that simulate region outage, variant incompatibility, and retirement window; telemetry shows expected routing
Migration metrics surfaced in Console: pin hit rate, fallback counts, perceived latency delta, quality regression flagging
tasks: Design policy DSL and examples (strict, permissive, regional-first, cost-first)
Schema change: extend /pins API to accept 'fallback_policy' object (region_order, variant_priority, max_latency_delta_ms, allow_degrade)
Console: add 'pin rescue' UI for configuring and previewing fallback ladders
Runtime: implement fallback ladder evaluator, capacity-aware scoring, and final decision API
Orchestration: implement deprecation workflow with states (announced, warning, auto-route, retired) and hooks for manual pause/rollback
Observability: add metrics, traces, and audit entries for every fallback decision; surface in per-pin dashboard
E2E tests and chaos scenarios (simulated regional loss, model kernel failure, variant mismatch)
Docs: customer-facing runbook and recommended migration patterns
Security review for API changes and audit logging (if required)
